text:
deploy-bot: preflight checks finished for release v3.4.2 -> HOLD: prompt-eval gate flagged embedding drift on 'search-relevance' suite (delta 7.8% > threshold 5%). see summary below.

mae (eng): copying the snippet — is this specific to the quantized variant or the float baseline?

liam (research): looks like only the 8-bit quantized build shows the drift, float32 and int16-green are fine. KV cache perf unaffected.

tara (qa): reproducing locally with our sample set: top-3 rerank drop and some paraphrase mismatches. attaching short log: 
```
FAILED: search-suite v3.4.2-q8 on sample-1000
metric: mean_recall@3 down 7.8% (p<0.01)
example: query "reset password" expected doc A but got doc C
```

rachel (product): how user-facing is this? does it affect autocomplete or just internal reranking?

liam (research): affects reranking for retrieval-augmented responses — users could see less relevant snippets in certain edge queries. Not catastrophic but noticeable on benchmarks.

mae (eng): ops options: full rollback, pin the quantized route to float32 for this customer cohort, or ship with a fallback routing rule (send <>50 token requests to float). Thoughts?

sam (sre): prefer a surgical fix — pin the model variant for the 'search' route in the changelist and enable routing fallback to baseline when similarity confidence < 0.7. avoids global rollback during change window.

tara (qa): can we get a quick hotfix for the quantized kernel? Might be a quantization mismatch in embedding projection. If hotfix ETA > 4h, we should pin.

mae (eng): quick checklist: 
- Option A (pin): update release manifest to pin search-route -> model:v3.4.2-f32 (config change) + add routing rule in release notes.
- Option B (fallback): runtime policy change to route low-confidence queries to f32. No code deploy.
- Option C (rollback): full rollback to v3.4.1. Heavy.

rachel (product): product prefers Option B (fallback) for minimal customer impact, plus note in release notes and monitoring alert to product metrics.

liam (research): agree Option B upfront, while we bisect quant kernel in parallel. If bisect finds a 1-line quant fix, we can push a quick patch and then remove the fallback.

ci-bot: deploy plan diff generated: 
```
+ route: search
  - variant: v3.4.2-q8 -> add fallback: confidence_threshold: 0.7 -> fallback_variant: v3.4.2-f32
- (no service restart required)
```

mae (eng): can someone own the actual release change (PR and release notes update)? I'll prep the PR for the routing rule.

tara (qa): I'll run an expanded sample against the fallback config in staging (test window 30m). If staging looks good, we ship the config to canary.

sam (sre): change window: we have a 2-hour maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. I'd prefer we push routing config at 02:10 after quick smoke.

rachel (product): add short note in release notes: "Temporarily enabling routing fallback for search reranking due to quantized embedding regression; users may see improved relevance for affected queries. Full fix anticipated within 48 hrs."

mae (eng): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deployments/pulls/8421 (WIP) — includes manifest pin + fallback rule. Assigning to @sam and @tara for staging signoff.

liam (research): starting bisect now, will report back within 3h or earlier if we find the offending kernel.

deploy-bot: scheduled config change at 2299504800 (02:10 UTC). It will apply to route `search` and create rollout: canary 10% -> 100% over 15m if canary health OK.

mae (eng): thanks all. tagging the gating checklist: 
- [ ] PR merged
- [ ] staging verification (tara)
- [ ] canary rollout (sam)
- [ ] release notes updated (rachel)
- [ ] post-deploy eval run pass (ci-bot)

tara (qa): staging smoke passed. metrics look stable. starting canary after sam's green.

sam (sre): starting canary now. monitoring dashboards pinned.

ci-bot: post-deploy eval: search-suite mean_recall@3 delta now within +0.4% after fallback -> PASS

mae (eng): moving PR to merged. releasing notes updated. leaving the fallback in place until liam confirms kernel fix.

liam (research): bisect found a quant-projection ordering bug, patch created and unit-tested. Target hotfix release in 6h.

rachel (product): great — please call out expected timeline in the release notes and send a short customer-facing blurb if we need to communicate.

mae (eng): will draft customer note after hotfix lands. closing the thread for now, will reopen if rollback needed. :white_check_mark:
